simple.meaning: תְּהוֹם (tᵉhôwm) is a Hebrew object word meaning “an abyss (as a surging mass of water), especially the deep (the main sea or the subterranean watersupply).” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 1:2. The surrounding context includes family.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to תְּהוֹם (H8415) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: תְּהוֹם (tᵉhôwm) / H8415 is traced through Genesis 1:2, Genesis 7:11, Genesis 8:2, Genesis 49:25 with generated occurrence evidence.

definitions.full: H8415. tehom תִּהוֺם noun feminine Gen 7:11 7 t. and masculine Job 28:14 5 t. (Albr ZAW xvi (1896), 62 Kö ii. 2. 167 Ency. Bib . DEEP ) deep, sea, abyss (almost always in poetry); — absolute ׳ת Gen 1:2 +; plural absolute תְּהֹמוֺת Psa 77:17 +, etc., ׳בַּתּ Isa 63:13 + Isa 106:9 (only here with article); construct תְּהוֺמוֺת Isa 71:20 (but see 5 infra); — 1 deep , of subterranean waters, Gen 49:25 (poem in J; opposed to שָׁמַיִם ), Deut 33:13 (opposed to id. ); ת מַעְיְנוֺת ׳רַבָּה Gen 7:11 ; 8:2 (P; || הַשָּׁמַיִם אֲרֻבֹּת ), ת ׳עִינוֺת Prov 8:28 (|| שְׁחָקִים ), Job 28:14 ; 38:16 (both || יָם ); רַבָּה תְּהוֺם Amos 7:4 (probably), ת ׳מִשְׁמָּטֶיךָ רַבָּה Psa 36:7 (opposed to כְּהַרְרֵי צִדְקָֽתְךָ אֵל ), Isa 51:10 (perhaps); so plural תְּהֹמוֺת , Prov 8:24 (|| מַעְיָנוֺת ), 3:20 (opposed to שְׁחָקִים ), and probably Psa 33:7 (|| הַיָּם מֵי ), 135:6 ( + יַמִּים ). 2 (deep) sea , overwhelming Tyre Ezek 26:19 (|| הָרַבִּים הַמַּיִם ), roaring at theoph. Hab 3:10 ; in General, || יָם , Job 38:30 ( ת ׳מְּנֵי ); || מַיִם Jonah 2:6 ; alonE Job 41:24 ; figurative, ׳ת ׳אֶלתֿ קוֺרַא 42:8 (|| גַּלִּים מִשְׁבָּרִים, ; but possibly here of Jordan, compare 4 ); in plural = abysses of sea, Exod 15:5 , 8 (of Red Sea, so) Isa 63:13 || Psa 106:9 ; 77:17 ; also 78:15 (in simile), 107:26 (poetic of hollows of great waves, opposed to שָׁמַיִם ); vaguely, כָּלתְּֿהֹמוֺת 135:6 ; 148:7 . 3 primaeval ocean, deep , in Hebrew cosmogony, ת ׳מְּנֵי Gen 1:2 (P; || הַמַּיִם מְּנֵי ), Prov 8:27 (|| שָׁמַיִם ), Psa 104:6 . — (compare, further, Gunk Schöpfung u. Chaos 21 ff. OCWhitehouse Hast. DB COSMOGONY Zim KAT3. 492 f., 509 f., 585 ). 4 deep, depth , of river Ezek 31:4 (Nile; || מַיִם , + נַהֲרוֺתֶיהָ ), 31:15 (|| id. ); plural of bursts of water fertilizing Canaan, ובהר בבקעה יוצאים Deut 8:7 ( + מַיִם נַחֲלֵי עֲיָנֹת, ). — On Psa 42:8 see 2. 5. abyss (si vera lectio): הָאָרֶץ תְּהוֺמוֺת = Shejôl , Psa 71:20 , but Ol We תַּחְתִיּוֺת . [ תַּחְמֻּכָה ] see הפך . תָּו see תוה . below, תּוֺא see תְּאוֺ . [ תּוֺאָם ] see תאם .
